metadata.title: The solvability of the $L_p$-dual mixed Euclidean-Gauss Minkowski problem
metadata.abstract: This paper investigates the $L_p$-dual mixed Euclidean-Gauss Minkowski problem associated with the $L_p$-dual mixed Euclidean-Gaussian curvature measure. The solvability of this problem is equivalent to that of a class of Monge-Ampère type equations on the unit sphere. Under smooth assumptions, We establish the existence of solutions for $p<1$, $q<0$, and $q<p$ and uniqueness of solutions for $p\geq q$ to the aforementioned Monge-Ampère type equations, respectively. Furthermore, we obtain a complete solution concerning the existence part of this problem when $p<1$ and $q<0$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究 Lp 对偶混合 Euclidean–Gaussian 曲率测度对应的球面 Monge–Ampère 方程，分别建立参数区间内的存在与唯一性。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展 p<1、q<0 区间内的存在理论。
analysis.limitations: 存在与唯一性使用不同参数条件；不能统一宣称全参数唯一可解。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 扩展 p<1、q<0 区间内的存在理论。
